cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women with a previous cesarean section who presented to the emergency department with pain and 100 pregnant women with a previous cesarean section without pain who were scheduled for elective cesarean section.
finding: An LUS thickness of <1.75 mm was identified as a critical cut-off value, associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture and a translucent uterine segment (C3).
cross-section timing: At term, at presentation to the emergency department (pain group) or prior to scheduled elective cesarean section (no pain group)
